name: phone-input
title: Phone Input
description: Phone field that cleans pasted input (separators, a leading 0, a doubled +91), picks the country from the dial and area code (+1 416 is Canada), warns on wrong digit counts, checks ranges and line types with libphonenumber, and reads back the E.164 value.

/**

 * libphonenumber metadata (mobile and fixed-line lengths only, so a toll-free length can't make a

 */

  /** English name, shown unless the field gets a `locale`. */

  /** Country calling code without the +. */

  /** Allowed national significant number lengths, [min, max]. */

  /** Domestic trunk prefix that is dropped when dialling internationally. */
  trunk?: string
  /** Digit groups used to display the national number. */

  /**
   * For a dial code shared by several countries (+1, +7, +44…): a regex the national number starts
   * with, e.g. "876|658" for Jamaica. Countries without one are the fallback; the first listed wins.

}

/** Parses a packed table in the format above, so a trimmed or extended copy can be built the same way. */
export function parsePhoneCountries(packed: string) {
  const out: Record<string, PhoneCountry> = {}
  for (const row of packed.split(";")) {
    const [code, name, dial, len, trunk, groups, ...leads] = row.split("|")
    const leading = leads.join("|")
    const [min, max = min] = len.split("-").map(Number)
    out[code] = { name, dial, lengths: [min, max], groups: groups.split(",").map(Number), ...(trunk && { trunk }), ...(leading && { leading }) }
  }
  return out
}

/** Every built-in country, keyed by ISO 3166 code. */
export const PHONE_COUNTRIES = parsePhoneCountries(DATA) as Record<PhoneCountryCode, PhoneCountry>

meta.summary: Cleans pasted phone numbers, picks the country from the dial code and checks the digits against libphonenumber ranges, so an unreachable number isn't saved.
catches: Separators, a leading trunk 0 and doubled country codes in pasted numbers
Country picked from the dial code and NANP area code
Too few or too many digits for the country
Line type that doesn't fit (landline or premium-rate where a mobile is expected)
E.164 readback of exactly what will be saved
limits: Format looks valid is not the same as reachable or owned; verify with an OTP
Numbering data comes from libphonenumber and needs updates as plans change
Country names are English unless you pass locale
a11y: Visible label; country picker has an aria-label
Input has aria-invalid on a warning and is described by a polite hint region
Flag and dial code visuals are aria-hidden
Animations are skipped under reduced motion
